$comment: THE source of truth for John's career. Every output (one-page PDF, ATS PDF/docx, long CV, markdown, LinkedIn blocks, search chunks 21/23/26/27/50, john-hanacek.json, media-kit boards) compiles from this file. Facts carry `evidence` (chunk ids, site pages, external links). Wording rules: did what, for whom, what came of it; numbers only where audited; no self-assessment adjectives. Nothing private lives here — the phone number and other application-only fields come from .local/private.json at compile time. Interview record: .local/mirror-interview.md (gitignored). Compiled 2026-09-09 from the 2026-09-09 interview.

rules: Company names may appear; client contacts' names do not.
Deliverable-level client detail is allowed; commercial terms, amounts and internal matters are not.
Pre-2015 work stays, compressed, on the one-page; full detail on the long CV.
OpenClaw is an agent framework. It is never a robotics system.
House prose rules (2026-09-16): one clause per sentence, no em dashes, no sentence built on what a thing is not, fact then stop, name never summarize. build-resume.mjs lints them.

designEngineer.label: Product Design Engineer (AI products)
designEngineer.summary: Product design engineer across AI, web, 3D and XR. Shipped Nanome 2's XR molecular design tool to pharma customers and an AR situational-awareness HUD for first responders. Built a portfolio site whose search runs a language model in the browser. Founding design for early-stage teams through JHDesign LLC. Prototypes in JavaScript, Three.js, WebGPU and Unity.

productDesigner.label: Product Designer (AI / agentic)
productDesigner.summary: Product designer with a research-led practice. Led product design for Nanome 2 on Meta Quest, the web portal and the MARA AI assistant. Ran 24 alpha and beta sessions with pharma scientists, coded the feedback, and shipped a navigation pivot. Designs agentic systems and the tools people use to run them, including a coaching product and client workshop systems.

foundingDesigner.label: Founding Designer
foundingDesigner.summary: Founding designer for early-stage teams since 2012, through JHDesign LLC since 2024. Brand, product and site delivered as working code: OpenProse went from brand to live homepage in two months, 137 live approaches, 471 commits. Co-founded AvatarMEDIC as CEO/CTO. Three hackathon and challenge wins. Founder Institute graduate. Runs workshops that leave teams with a system they operate themselves.

xr.label: XR / Spatial Designer
xr.summary: XR product designer across Meta Quest, HoloLens 2 and visionOS. Lead XR Product Designer at Nanome: Spotlight/Follow collaboration, the non-rivalrous molecule, wrist UI. Immersive UX at BadVR: the AROC HUD, hand tracking, SeeSignal. XR robot control that won the Aerospace Medical Association's R&D Innovation Award. Speaker at AWE USA 2024. Contributor to Spatial Design: Breaking the 2D Paradigm.

storyDesigner.label: Product Designer: Storytelling, Entertainment & Experiential
storyDesigner.headline: Product Designer · Storytelling, AI, 3D & XR · 14 years
storyDesigner.summary: Product designer and interactive media artist across product, XR and story. Led product design for Nanome 2 on Meta Quest, shipped to scientists at Pfizer and Novartis. Designed AR situational-awareness HUDs at BadVR. Built story-driven concepts end to end at AvatarMEDIC: visual design, animatics and composite shots. CGI compositing and 3D animation in After Effects, Blender and Unity, for screen and XR. Actor with two IMDb-listed short-film credits. Prototypes generated with Claude and brought into Figma. Ships design systems, brand and working code.

highlights.text: Co-founded a medtech startup for remote trauma intervention through XR telepresence and robotics. Led strategy, pitching, concept and engineering direction. Founder Institute SF (2020).
Built the Unity robot demo, visual design, animatics and composites. The digital-twin robotic medical assistant won the Aerospace Medical Association's R&D Innovation Award (2022).
HoloTRIAGE: AR first-aid triage training on the unreleased HoloLens 2, three victims with scenario props. Microsoft Reactor hackathon winner (2020).
A1R, Augmented First Responder: lead product designer with a project manager and a developer. NIST CHARIoT Challenge Phase 2 winner (2021).
SAR 5G: lead designer on a search-and-rescue app for Magic Leap One and 5G. AT&T 5G Hackathon winner, Best 5G use case (2019).
Analog astronaut missions to gather data for the concept. Pivoted the company to consultancy before stepping away.
Brand, content and the company website.
Product design and interactive mockups, remote.
Pedagogical tools. Co-authored EDULEARN15 research on the spread of technology-enhanced teaching.
